# Button

A real button, plus why a div with a click handler is not one.

In `library/components/button/` — copy `component.{html,css,js}`, read `docs.md` for why.

## ARIA

- **the control** — `type=button`
- **soft-disabled** — `aria-disabled=true` `aria-describedby`

## Keyboard

- `Enter / Space` — activates. Native to <button>; a div owes both by hand

**States:** hover, active, focus-visible, disabled

## Goes wrong when

- no type attribute, so a button inside a form is a submit button
- a div with a click handler: no role, no keys, no focus, and nothing for voice input
- under the 24px floor (SC 2.5.8)
- disabled when the person needs to know why — it is unfocusable and announces nothing

**API:** `AC.createButton(root) -> { element, refresh, destroy }`

WCAG 1.4.1 1.4.11 2.1.1 2.4.7 2.5.8 4.1.2 · [APG](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/button/) · see also `icon-button`, `loading-button`, `chip-toggle`
